**Triage: lands in `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts` (the `ApproverType` `.describe()`) ⇒ `domain:spec`; `Task`; `priority:p3`; `pm:queue`.**

分诊席 · `session_017VGfRocA8VjczSe84fgjY3` · R+176 · 2026-09-11T01:0xZ · 本评论来自分诊座位. Readings on `origin/main` @ `abc4b83ce8b01d4e5af3560a0547421f6f5ca98f`.

✅ The routing the filing seat measured is upheld: the page is auto-generated from that zod file, so closing it means editing describe prose — which the lane table puts in `domain:spec` explicitly (「describe/JSDoc/墓碑散文/错误 guidance 与 alias 表」).

### Why `Task` and not `Bug`

`manager` is **implemented**: the runtime resolves it against `sys_user.manager_id` and does what it says. The gap is that the column cannot be populated in-product — ⚠️ upstream of this text, and the subject of **#16678**. ⇒ no declared contract is contradicted here, so 判据 gives `Task`, ⛔ not `Bug`.

⚠️ Contrast with its sibling **#17573**, graded `Bug` minutes ago: there the runtime **refuses** `queue` in its own voice while the page sells it. Declared ≠ enforced is the discriminator, and it fires on one card and not the other.

### ⭐ The "⛔ do not write a third one" worry dissolves — and the way it dissolves is the direction

The card is right that a third drifting copy of the remedy would be the harm, and right that two byte-identical statements already exist (`MANAGER_ONLY_REMEDY` / `MANAGER_ONLY_ROUTES` at `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.ts:147,156`, and PR #17575's callout). Measured, the three ways out are not equal:

| route | mechanically possible? | cost |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **(i)** third copy + a byte-identity pin test | yes | a third string to keep in step; the pin catches drift **after** it happens |
| **(ii)** hoist the constant into `packages/spec`, import it from lint | ✅ yes — `packages/lint` already depends on `@objectstack/spec` (`package.json:44`, `workspace:*`) and `packages/spec` depends on lint **0** times, so the direction is clean | ⛔ it makes the string part of `@objectstack/spec`'s **public surface** (`api-surface/data.json`, the export ledgers) — 扩大公开面 ⇒ the maintainer floor |
| **(iii)** ⭐ the describe **points** at the remedy instead of restating it | yes | nothing to keep in step: a pointer cannot drift into disagreement with what it points at |

**Default: (iii) — declared, ⛔ veto window not a permission gate.** An enum member's `.describe()` does not need to carry a 667-character remedy; it needs to stop offering `manager` unqualified and say where the remedy lives. ⇒ 「让正确形态成唯一拼写」 is satisfied by having **exactly one place that states the remedy**, which is what the lint constants already are. ⚠️ If the round finds (iii) cannot be made to read well in the generated page, say so in the PR body and take (i) **with** the pin test — ⛔ never (i) without it.

⇒ ⛔ **(ii) is fenced.** Do not add an export to `packages/spec` on this card. If the round concludes the constant genuinely belongs there, **stop and report** — that is a public-surface addition and a separate decision.

### ⚠️ Live coupling — #16678 went to the maintainer's decision box tonight

**#16678** is now `needs-user-decision` (this round), asking whether `manager_id` gains a product write surface at all. ⇒ ⚠️ **whatever wording lands here is conditional on that answer**, exactly like the strings already in the tree.

`validate-approval-approvers.ts:136-140` already carries the carrier for this, verbatim:

> ⛔ DEPENDENCY — #16678 holds the open question of whether `manager_id` should GAIN a product write surface. If it ever does, these strings are the lines that go stale … Update them in the same change that opens the write surface

⇒ ⭐ **The PR that lands this card adds its own new text to that list**, in the same change. ⛔ A new copy of the caveat that is *not* named in that docblock is a line nobody will know to update — which is the same drift the card is trying to prevent, arrived at from the other side.

⚠️ ⛔ This card is **not** `pm:blocked` on #16678. The qualification is correct today under every one of #16678's three options: even under option A or B the column would need populating before `manager` resolves, so 「this depends on a provisioned reporting chain」 stays true; only the *remedy sentence* would change. ⇒ dispatchable now.

### Why p3

- The author-facing pages — `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` and `content/docs/capabilities/approvals.mdx` — **already carry the qualification** as of PR #17575. This is the *generated reference* page, which an author reaches after the two pages that now warn them.
- `manager` **works** once the column is populated; nothing is refused, nothing is inverted, no record is stranded by this text alone.
- ⇒ it is the literal remainder of #16678's acceptance criterion 「`ApproverType` 的文档处写明……」, ⛔ not an independent live defect. **p3.**

### ⛔ Fences

- ⛔ **Do not edit `content/docs/references/automation/approval.mdx`.** Its own banner says `⚠️ AUTO-GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT. Run build-docs.ts to regenerate.` The edit is in the zod file; the page follows from regeneration.
- ⛔ **Do not change `ApproverType`'s shape** — no member added, removed, or renamed. Describe prose only.
- ⛔ **Do not re-word the `manager` callouts PR #17575 landed.** They are current, and #16678 is under an open decision.
- ⛔ Do not touch `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` or the write guards. This card publishes a fact; it does not change one.

### Dedupe

582-issue open board, run 2026-09-11T01:0xZ (rendered from the scan's output):

| pattern | open hits |
|---|---|
| `ApproverType` | **3** — #17579, #16678, #6021 |
| `MANAGER_ONLY_REMEDY\|MANAGER_ONLY_ROUTES` | **1** — #17579 |
| `references/automation/approval\.mdx` | **1** — #17579 |
| `manager_id` (control) | **6** — #17579, #16870, #16678, #11286, #6023, #6021 |

⛔ **No duplicate.** **#16678** is the write-surface decision (now `needs-user-decision`) — the cause, ⛔ not this text. **#17573** is the same page family but the `queue` claim in `domain:devx`. **#6021** / **#6023** are `pm:seat` posts. **#16870** / **#11286** are `manager_id` keyword adjacency.

`Size/model suggestion:` S — one `.describe()` string, a regenerate, and one line added to the dependency docblock in `packages/lint`. ⚠️ That last line is the part a round is most likely to skip; it is not optional.

### Declared file face

`packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts` (the `ApproverType` `.describe()` text) and the **regenerated** `content/docs/references/automation/approval.mdx`.

⭐ **Face-disjointness measured, not assumed** (2026-09-11T06:15Z). In flight in this lane: #17344 (`ui/dashboard.zod.ts`), #17157 (`system/cache.zod.ts`). No intersection.

### Why `Clause-②: no`

The gate defines it as *"this PR puts a **new key** on a published payload"* (`scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs:763-765`, read from the gate). Rewriting a `.describe()` string adds no key. ⚠️ If the diff ends up adding one, the declaration is wrong: **stop and report**; ⛔ do not edit this line yourself.

⚠️ **Put the declaration in the PR BODY as its own line too.** Measured today on PR #17635: `check-clause2-carriers --pair` reads the **card's** claim and can exit 0 while CI's `Check Changeset` — which reads the **PR body** — refuses for want of a line there. Two different carriers. A heading like `## Clause-② …` is a **near miss**, not a declaration. ⛔ The remedy is always the declaration, never dropping the changeset or regrading a package to quiet the gate.

### The generated page is generated — ⛔ do not hand-edit it

`content/docs/references/automation/approval.mdx` carries `⚠️ AUTO-GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT. Run build-docs.ts to regenerate.` ⇒ change the `.describe()` in the zod file and **run the repo's generator**. ⛔ Never hand-edit the generated page, and ⛔ never hand-edit a lockfile or other generated artefact either.

### What the round must falsify first

Take every anchor **by state on `origin/main`**, ⛔ never from this card and ⛔ never from this note — PR #17575 merged from #16678 and moved the neighbourhood:

1. `ApproverType`'s `manager` describe still reads unqualified, at its real line in `automation/approval.zod.ts`.
2. `content/docs/references/automation/approval.mdx:113-117` still sells it, and the banner still names that zod file as its source.
3. ⭐ The claim the whole card rests on — that `sys_user.manager_id` has **no product write surface** — is still true. Re-measure it, do not inherit it: the data API refusal (`plugin-auth/src/identity-write-guard.test.ts:186` and `:132`), no accepting route under `/api/v1/auth/**`, `readonly: true` on the column. **If any write surface now exists, the card's premise is void: stop and report.**
4. What PR #17575 already fixed — ⛔ do not redo the hand-written half.

A stop-and-report backed by evidence is a **good outcome**, not a failed round.

### Instrument discipline

⭐ **A green run is a reading only if the instrument could have come back the other way.** If you probe the write surface, show the **negative leg**: a field that IS writable must pass the same probe that `manager_id` fails. A refusal that refuses everything proves nothing. ⚠️ `grep -c` counts LINES, not occurrences — use `grep -o | wc -l`. ⛔ Never grep file CONTENTS for what is only a file NAME. ⛔ Report a discarded run rather than silently retrying it; a prerequisite refusal is not a red.

### Scope

Say what is true about `manager` — ⛔ do not remove the enum member (that is a different, larger question and would need its own ruling). ⛔ Do not touch `content/docs/releases/`. Changeset required; a `.describe()` change ships in published dist, so grade it honestly. Commit trailers are **model-free**: `Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` and `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`; ⛔ no model identifier anywhere in the repo. Draft PR, `Part of #17579` unless it genuinely closes the whole question.

## Closing — landed and verified by CONTENT on `main`

`domain:spec` execution seat, 2026-09-11T08:20Z. **PR #17640 merged 2026-09-11T08:17:28Z.** It used `Part of`, ⛔ not `Fixes`, so GitHub did not close this card — the seat decides it.

### The card was wrong in its spelling, and the round said so

This card reports that `ApproverType`'s `.describe()` "still offers `manager` unqualified". Measured on `main`, **there was no `.describe()` at all** — its JSDoc renders nowhere, because the generator prints `mainDef.description`, which only `.describe()` / `.meta({description})` fills. So the page showed `## ApproverType`, an `### Allowed Values` list, and nothing else: `manager` read exactly like the nine members that work.

⭐ The round proved that mechanism with a **positive control** rather than asserting it — `HttpMethod`'s `.describe()` does render on its own reference page — so "the JSDoc renders nowhere" is a reading, not an inference. The card's substance stands; the fix is a describe **added**, not edited.

⇒ It qualifies the rung **and points at the remedy**, instead of leaving an author to discover it by shipping a stuck approval.

### The write-surface claim was re-measured, with its negative leg lit

The card's premise is that `sys_user.manager_id` has no product write surface. ⭐ The round drove the **real** `beforeUpdate` guard rather than reading the source:
